$comment: drift-rdp CI version pins (task 1.4). Source of truth for the container
and native command contract; keep in sync with .dagger/src/pins.ts (the
Dagger module cannot read repository files outside .dagger/ at module
load time) and with $DriftNextestMinVersion in scripts/Invoke-CI.ps1.
Cross-file consistency is enforced by scripts/Invoke-CI.Tests.ps1 (CT03,
CT04d). NEVER use floating image tags; every image pin carries an exact
version tag plus its multi-arch index digest (sha256).

dagger.runnerHostNote: Windows dev host engine discovery (task 1.3 finding): scripts/Invoke-CI.ps1 sets _EXPERIMENTAL_DAGGER_RUNNER_HOST=image+podman://<engineImage> itself; GitHub-hosted Linux runners use their Docker engine and do not set this variable.

node.note: Repo CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs Node 22; 22.23.4 is the current head of the 22 line (digest verified 2026-11-11 via Docker Hub).

rust.note: Local host and CI @stable currently resolve to 1.98.1; the active spec's target-state MSRV is 1.89 (src-tauri Cargo.toml rust-version bump is later spec work, not this pin).

nextest.note: cargo-nextest is CI/developer tooling, never an application dependency. Pinned prebuilt release tarball (the get.nexte.st convenience URL resolves to an unpinned floating release, which this repository forbids). Same pin as nextest-version.required in src-tauri/.config/nextest.toml and $DriftNextestMinVersion in scripts/Invoke-CI.ps1.
